extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'(x) = n x^(n-1) for f(x) = x^n with real n.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[c f(x)] = c f'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Instantaneous rate of change of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiable function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function whose derivative exists at a point or on an interval.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operation that produces a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function built from powers of x with coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function of the form a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural exponential function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: General exponential function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function a^x with base a.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Unique number satisfying lim_{h->0}(e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit definition of e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit condition that defines the number e.

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Change in a quantity per change in another quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of position with respect to time.

extracted_concepts.name: Position
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Position function s(t) describing location over time.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of velocity with respect to time.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative of cost with respect to quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Cost function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function C(x) giving cost for quantity x.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent line approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Estimation of function values near a point using the tangent line.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operation inverse to differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Theorem connecting differentiation and integration.

extracted_concepts.name: Real exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponent n that may be any real number.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fixed value c in a formula.
